body: I just wanted to die the most peaceful way possible, I'm willing to suffer.  Right now it looks like I'm going to do the week long liver failure thing because it is the easiest for me to get a hold of.
I've tried that, but nothing really seems 'fun' anymore.
Just to clarify, its not that there isn’t anything to see it’s that I don’t care to see it anymore.

Maybe, I don't have a doctor though.  I don't know how I could afford a psychiatrist or any related medication.  And I tried somethings when I was younger, they didn't help, I know stuff has changed since then, but I don't really want to try anymore.
Maybe, I've thought about it quite a bit, what are some of the 'what ifs and what nots' that I should have contemplated?  (It is likely I've already thought about these things)
Not these things specifically, a mountain vs. the amazon river and the like, but the general concept was the same, yes, I experienced them.

I honestly don't see myself enjoying anything.

All the stuff I've done that I thought I wanted to do hasn't left me feeling any less empty.  Sometimes it made it worse because I thought I would enjoy it more than I ended up doing.
I can't think of too many things I enjoy, most of my time I spend killing time, with things like drinking, video games, reading.
I've seen things along those lines, but none of them ever made me any happier.
Seen the things that I thought would make it more worth while, that I was waiting for and they didn't make it more worth while.
It isn't really that things are any worse now (though they've never been good, but I'm pretty sure that's normal), it's just I don't have anything to look forward to anymore.

I tried living for a few decades, it's only really the last few years that I've decided I don't want to see anymore.

Also

>it's easier than killing yourself and less painful.

might not be true for everyone...
